## What it is

**What it is:** A publishing platform for blogs, newsletters and paid memberships, with an editor, themes and built-in email newsletters.

**Sub-tags:** website (docs/design/TAXONOMY.md §1).

**Icon:** `icon.svg` is a neutral generated initials icon, not the upstream logo.

## How it is packaged

- **Images:** the official `docker.io/library/ghost:6.77.0-alpine` (the `6-alpine` line used by upstream's `TryGhost/ghost-docker` compose file) and `docker.io/library/mysql:8.0.46`, the database and pin that file uses.
- **User:** the Ghost entrypoint switches to `node` only when started as root; this pod starts as `node` (UID/GID 1000). MySQL runs as its image user `mysql` (UID 999).
- **Database:** MySQL is a native sidecar listening on 127.0.0.1 only, so only this pod reaches it. That is why its root account has no password and no Secret exists (contract §11.2 forbids committed Secrets).
- **State:** PVCs `ghost-content` (5 Gi, themes, images and files) and `ghost-db` (5 Gi, MySQL data).
- **Health:** probes on `GET /ghost/api/admin/site/` (public site information); MySQL with `mysqladmin ping`.
- **Security:** `runAsNonRoot`, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, all Linux capabilities dropped, `RuntimeDefault` seccomp, no service-account token. One replica with the `Recreate` strategy, so two pods never write the same volume.

## First run

From the upstream documentation, https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker:

1. Open `/ghost` on the app's web address (port 2368) and create the owner account and site title.
2. Ghost builds links from its `url` setting, which this package sets to `http://localhost:2368`. Set the `url` environment variable of the `ghost` container to the address readers use, then restart.
3. Configure email (Mailgun or SMTP) before inviting staff or sending newsletters (https://docs.ghost.org/config#mail).

## Known limits in this package

- The `url` above is the one setting that needs the real address; until then, links and redirects point at `localhost`.
- No mail is configured, so staff invites and newsletters do not send.
- Upstream's Caddy (TLS) and the optional ActivityPub and analytics services are not packaged.

## Why this app is blocked

The CI app gate (`sdk/tools/app-gate`, contract §9.4) computed tier **blocked** for this app on 2026-11-12 (ci-apps run 43216348408, job `gate (ghost)`). The gateway lists a blocked app in the Market but refuses to install it (§10.3, §11.1). The app is kept, not hidden, and the gate was not weakened. Reasons from that run:

- Vulnerability: `docker.io/library/ghost:6.77.0-alpine`: CVE-2025-68121 in Go `stdlib` v1.24.6 (fixed 1.24.13, 1.25.7, 1.26.0-rc.3).
- Vulnerability: `docker.io/library/mysql:8.0.46`: GHSA-6q48-6c7w-9gw2 in `certifi` 2026.2.25 (fixed 2026.10.18); CVE-2025-68121 in Go `stdlib` v1.24.6.
- Secret findings (Trivy): 13 in the ghost image: `jwt-token` and `sendgrid-api-token` (MEDIUM) and one `private-key` (HIGH), under `/var/lib/ghost/.pnpm-store/` and in the built admin assets `/var/lib/ghost/versions/6.77.0/core/built/admin/assets/*.js` (strings in upstream's own JavaScript and dependencies).
- Passed: ClamAV (0 infected), smoke test (GET / returned 200).

To unblock: move the pins to upstream releases that fix these findings (tags that exist, checked with `crane`), then rerun `sdk/tools/app-gate` (the daily `apps-rescan` workflow does this too). Nothing is bumped to an unverified tag.

**Hold (apps/market-unblock-2, 2026-11-13):** Go `stdlib` in the Ghost image; `certifi` and Go in `mysql:8.0.46` (the newest 8.0 tag); 13 secret-shaped strings in upstream JS. Unblock: rebuilt Ghost and MySQL 8.0 images. The registry was re-read on 2026-11-13: the pinned digest is unchanged and no newer fixed tag exists, so nothing is bumped (the gate was not weakened and the tier was not edited). It unblocks when the weekly `apps-rescan` or a manual `apps-gate-all` run computes a pass on a rebuilt image. No upstream issue link was looked up (the GitHub API is not reachable from the worker).
